jd_text: About the Client: Our client is looking for a results-driven Head of Digital Transformation to lead enterprise-wide digital innovation across operations, supply chain, and commercial functions. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in driving transformation initiatives and a strong understanding of emerging technologies, including IoT, blockchain, AI, and advanced data analytics. They should also have a proven track record of delivering measurable business outcomes. This leadership role will be crucial in modernizing the organization’s infrastructure, improving operational efficiency, enhancing data-driven decision-making, and enabling sustainable food production for the future Key Responsibilities Define and lead the overall digital transformation strategy in alignment with business growth and sustainability goal Drive implementation of cutting-edge technologies across the supply chain, including: IoT (e.g., smart farming, sensor-based monitoring), Blockchain (e.g., traceability and supply chain transparency), AI/ML (e.g., demand forecasting, predictive maintenance, process optimization Collaborate cross-functionally with teams in operations, supply chain, R&D, commercial, and sustainability to ensure a scalable and integrated digital solution Oversee project execution using modern project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, SAFe) and lead change management initiatives across business units Manage external partnerships with technology vendors, digital solution providers, startups, and innovation labs Develop internal capabilities by mentoring teams, leading digital literacy programs, and fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning Define KPIs and monitor the impact of digital initiatives on productivity, environmental footprint, and financial performance Present outcomes and strategic direction to executive stakeholders and board members Qualifications & Requirements Minimum 15 years of experience, with at least 5 years in a digital leadership role Strong understanding of IoT, blockchain, AI/ML, and digital infrastructure Proven track record in leading an enterprise digital transformation program Experience in food production, agriculture, manufacturing, or supply chain sectors preferred Solid foundation in project and change management Strong stakeholder engagement skills, including executive-level communication Fluent in English; Arabic is a plus
